title: Implement Reset-Zone Hazards and Restroom 005
objective: Add validated optional reset_zone level data, reusable spatial hazards, safe in-place player recovery that preserves all heist progress, and a compact restroom_005 demonstration without changing accepted pickup, door, character, or movement behavior.
acceptance: optional hazards normalize to an empty array for restroom_001 through restroom_004, while reset_zone fields normalize to typed values with a 0.75-second default cooldown
duplicate IDs, unsupported types, malformed position/size/reset_position, missing reset_position, non-positive size components, and non-positive cooldown fail closed with field-specific errors

a reusable visible hazard scene exposes Area3D/CollisionShape3D aligned to configured position and size, supports only reset_zone, registers by ID, and emits deterministic registration/trigger/reset markers

only the active player triggers a hazard; unrelated physics bodies are ignored; each legitimate entry increments activation_count exactly once, cooldown blocks storms, and later re-entry increments again
RestroomRuntime applies the configured reset_position in the current scene and clears CharacterBody3D velocity without changing normal movement, gait, camera, model, or collision behavior
a hazard reset preserves collected_turds, collected toilet state, trigger_fired and trigger_fire_count, door OPEN state and open_count, unlocked exit state, and the ability to complete the heist
no scene reload, health, lives, damage, death, checkpoints, audio, moving hazards, projectiles, or generic action scripting is introduced

restroom_005 has 7-10 collectibles, 2-4 empty toilets, exactly two doors/triggers, 2-3 meaningful avoidable hazards, 3-4 areas, safe reset positions, reachable threshold collectibles, no reset loop, and no soft lock
TB-001, TB-002, TB-003, TB-H01, TB-R01, TB-R02, TB-R03, TB-R03A, TB-R04 identity, TB-R04B, TB-R04C, TB-R05, TB-R06, and TB-R07 pass individually
Godot validation, six required hazard screenshots, Linux x86_64 export, and exported runtime loading/self-test of restroom_001 through restroom_005 all pass
tests, prior levels, existing door/trigger authority, pickup behavior, character aesthetics, movement/camera/collision, audio, assets, and unrelated gameplay do not change
